purpose: Dedicated B5 phase-A/phase-B memory replay Gate

phases.phase_a: old memory episodes written before the task switch
phases.phase_b: same-cue contradictory interference followed by novel-cue control episodes
phases.replay: phase-A train episodes replayed after phase B

holdout_rule: all phase-A and phase-B holdout/retention queries are read-only
promotion_rule: replay must retain old phase-A holdout and retention for every seed, beat no-replay, preserve phase-B capability, and use no holdout writes
